items.title: Record snowstorm buries St. Louis on Thanksgiving
items.feedTitle: Major snowstorm buries St. Louis in time for Thanksgiving
items.summary: A major winter storm dumped record-breaking snowfall across the St. Louis region on Thanksgiving, with the National Weather Service confirming 5.2 inches at Lambert Airport and over 11 inches in some areas like Jefferson County. The heavy, wet snow caused widespread power outages affecting approximately 125,000 homes across the St. Louis metro and metro-east areas. Ameren warned that power restoration could take multiple days, and the wet snow was heavy enough to collapse the Wentzville Ice Arena's roof.

items.title: Powerful US storms disrupt Thanksgiving travel nationwide
items.feedTitle: Powerful storms disrupt holiday travel, as Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade is postponed
items.summary: Severe weather including heavy rain, strong winds, high tides, and flooding impacted an estimated 81.5 million people traveling across the United States during the Thanksgiving holiday. The storms forced the postponement of Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade for the first time in its 100-year history and caused widespread disruptions to flight schedules and coastal infrastructure. Multiple regions from the East Coast to California reported significant damage and flooding risks.

items.title: High school football game shooting kills one in Massachusetts
items.feedTitle: 1 person killed in shooting after football game at Chelsea High School, DA says
items.summary: One person was fatally shot during a fight that erupted on the sidelines of a high school football game at Chelsea High School in Massachusetts. Local authorities are investigating the incident that occurred after the game ended. The shooting represents another instance of violence at a youth sporting event.

items.title: ICE arrests Massachusetts lottery winner days after claiming prize
items.feedTitle: Man claimed $1M Massachusetts lottery prize. Days later, ICE arrested him
items.summary: A man who won a $1 million Massachusetts lottery prize was detained by ICE just days after claiming his jackpot. The arrest highlights immigration enforcement actions occurring even as individuals attempt to claim legitimate winnings and integrate into the financial system.

items.title: Judge blocks FCC from early review of ABC broadcast licenses
items.feedTitle: Trump, FCC illegally sought to punish ABC in free speech case, judge rules
items.summary: A federal judge blocked the Trump administration's FCC from conducting an early review of ABC's broadcast licenses, finding that the network's free speech rights were being chilled by the administration's actions. The judge agreed with ABC that the FCC's actions were motivated by political retaliation rather than legitimate regulatory concerns.

stlouis.title: Record snowstorm buries St. Louis on Thanksgiving
stlouis.feedTitle: Metro-east, St. Louis under a winter storm watch for possible ‘heavy’ snow - Belleville News-Democrat
stlouis.summary: A major winter storm dumped record-breaking snowfall across the St. Louis region on Thanksgiving, with the National Weather Service confirming 5.2 inches at Lambert Airport and over 11 inches in some areas like Jefferson County. The heavy, wet snow caused widespread power outages affecting approximately 125,000 homes across the St. Louis metro and metro-east areas. Ameren warned that power restoration could take multiple days, and the wet snow was heavy enough to collapse the Wentzville Ice Arena's roof.

stlouis.title: 125,000 St. Louis homes without power after Thanksgiving snowstorm
stlouis.feedTitle: Lost power on Thanksgiving? What to know as 125,000 homes in St. Louis region wait for crews
stlouis.summary: The heavy Thanksgiving snowstorm left approximately 125,000 homes across the St. Louis region and metro-east without power. Ameren utility officials indicated that power restoration could take days as crews work to clear downed lines and assess storm damage. The outage affected a significant portion of the metropolitan area during the holiday period.

stlouis.title: Wet snow and aging trees caused massive power outages in St. Louis
stlouis.feedTitle: Why did the St. Louis snow knock out so much Ameren power? Wet snow, trees and an old problem
stlouis.summary: The widespread power outages across St. Louis were caused by a combination of heavy, wet snow and the region's aging infrastructure, particularly mature trees that brought down power lines under the weight of snow accumulation. Experts noted that the region's tree canopy and aging utility infrastructure made it particularly vulnerable to major storm impacts.

items.title: Two Italian workers killed in Kuwait drone strike
items.feedTitle: Two Italians killed in strike in Kuwait, as Iran denies responsibility
items.summary: Two Italian technicians working for German defense contractor Rheinmetall were killed in a strike on Kuwait's air defense system. Iran has denied responsibility for the attack, though Italian authorities and media reports attributed it to an Iranian drone strike. The incident marks an escalation of regional tensions and potential foreign involvement in Middle Eastern conflicts.

items.title: Egypt detains driver in Cairo fuel tanker crash that killed 31
items.feedTitle: Egypt detains a driver suspected of causing Cairo tanker crash that killed 31
items.summary: Egyptian authorities arrested a driver suspected of causing a massive fuel tanker fire near Cairo that killed at least 31 people. Officials say the man confessed to traveling at excessive speed and clipping the fuel truck while attempting to overtake traffic, triggering the explosion. The incident represents one of Egypt's deadliest transportation accidents in recent years.

items.title: Spanish economist chosen as next ECB president
items.feedTitle: Spain’s Pablo Hernández de Cos wins race to be next ECB president
items.summary: Spain's Pablo Hernández de Cos, former governor of the Bank of Spain, has been selected as the next president of the European Central Bank, succeeding Christine Lagarde. The choice came after winning support from the EU's major economies at a eurozone leaders' meeting. Hernández de Cos will take on a critical role managing monetary policy for the eurozone.

items.title: UK-EU treaty includes 10-year termination clause for future exits
items.feedTitle: New UK-EU treaty has 10-year termination clause
items.summary: The published text of the UK-EU post-Brexit treaty includes a 10-year termination clause that would allow either side to exit the agreement, according to the BBC. The treaty grants ministers significant powers to enact even closer ties with Brussels in future, though it stops short of pursuing rejoining the single market or customs union.

items.title: Cheaper HIV prevention injection reaches Africa via UN programs
items.feedTitle: Hope for millions as cheaper HIV prevention jab reaches Africa
items.summary: Lenacapavir, a twice-yearly injectable HIV prevention medication that is nearly 100% effective, has begun reaching African nations through UN-coordinated programs at significantly lower costs than previously available. The drug represents a major advance in HIV prevention technology and accessibility for populations at high risk of infection.

items.title: Sheikh Hasina's return gambit tests Bangladesh political fault lines
items.feedTitle: Sheikh Hasina’s return gambit tests Bangladesh’s political fault lines
items.summary: Former Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina is reportedly considering a return to the country amid ongoing political tensions. Her potential comeback would test the nation's political stability and relations with neighboring India, given the significant role India played in her previous government. The move comes as Bangladesh navigates internal divisions and external pressures.

items.title: Amended Delimitation Bill likely tabled in special Parliament sitting
items.feedTitle: Amended Delimitation Bill likely to be tabled in special Parliament sitting from November 30
items.summary: India's Union Cabinet is expected to meet on November 27 to clear an amended Delimitation Bill, which is likely to be introduced in a special Parliament sitting beginning November 30. The bill relates to redrawing of electoral boundaries, a politically sensitive matter in Indian politics.

items.title: India needs $500 billion annually for net-zero by 2070
items.feedTitle: India needs $500 billion a year for net zero by 2070, report says
items.summary: A new report indicates that India requires approximately $500 billion per year in investment to achieve its net-zero emissions target by 2070. The massive funding requirement highlights the scale of India's climate transition challenge and the need for both domestic and international financial commitments.

items.title: Tamil Nadu introduces 15 days paternity leave for government employees
items.feedTitle: Tamil Nadu introduces 15 days of paternity leave for married government employees
items.summary: Tamil Nadu state has announced a new policy providing 15 days of paternity leave for married government employees. The policy aims to support work-life balance and promote shared parenting responsibilities among state government workers.

items.title: India administers 10 million HPV vaccine doses in nine months
items.feedTitle: India Administers 1 Crore HPV Vaccine Doses In Less Than Nine Months
items.summary: India has administered 10 million doses of the HPV vaccine in less than nine months, marking significant progress in its cervical cancer prevention efforts. The rapid rollout demonstrates India's capacity to scale health interventions across its large population.

immigration.title: IBM ends H-1B visa sponsorship for consulting roles
immigration.feedTitle: IBM ends H-1B Visa, Green Card sponsorship for most consulting roles; employees asked to relocate or exit
immigration.summary: IBM has announced it is ending H-1B visa and green card sponsorship for most of its consulting positions, giving employees three weeks to either relocate to another country or resign. The decision affects hundreds of Indian technology workers and represents a significant shift in IBM's hiring strategy amid changing client needs and visa dynamics. This is a major shift affecting H-1B holders' ability to remain in the US.

immigration.title: DOL proposes sweeping modernization of PERM labor certification
immigration.feedTitle: Modernizing the Labor Market Test and Improving Protections for U.S. Workers in the PERM Immigrant Visa Program
immigration.summary: The US Department of Labor has proposed major changes to the PERM labor certification program for green card sponsorship, including 90-day recruitment periods and a 2-year layoff bar for employers. The proposed rule, still under review and not finalized, aims to strengthen protections for US workers while modernizing the green card process. These changes could significantly tighten requirements for employers seeking to sponsor foreign workers for permanent positions.

immigration.title: State Department pauses immigrant visas for 75 high-risk countries
immigration.feedTitle: Update: State Dep't Pause on Immigrant Visas for Nationals of 75 Countries "At High Risk of Public Charge Usage"
immigration.summary: The State Department has paused immigrant visa processing for nationals of 75 countries deemed at high risk of public charge usage, temporarily halting visa interviews worldwide as consular officers receive training on updated public charge rules. This policy change, finalized and now in effect, affects applicants from multiple nations seeking permanent residency in the US.

items.title: Global stocks rally as AI trade rebounds on Thanksgiving
items.feedTitle: Stocks, Nasdaq Futures Climb as AI Trade Rebounds: Markets Wrap
items.summary: Global stock markets rallied on Thanksgiving as investors rebounded from recent tech selloffs, with particular strength in AI-related sectors. The recovery came as markets globally responded positively to US economic resilience and reduced jitters over tariff uncertainty. Major indices showed gains across developed and emerging markets.

items.title: Altria explores takeover bid for UK tobacco rival Imperial Brands
items.feedTitle: Marlboro Maker Altria Explores Deal for Rival Imperial Brands
items.summary: US tobacco giant Altria announced it is exploring a possible takeover bid for UK-based Imperial Brands, the maker of Davidoff cigarettes and other brands. Imperial's shares jumped over 14% on the news, reflecting investor expectations of a potential deal. The move represents significant cross-border M&A activity in the declining but profitable tobacco sector.

items.title: JPMorgan expects Nifty 50 at 29,000 by end of 2027
items.feedTitle: Nifty at 29,000 by end-2027; three more RBI rate hikes expected: JP Morgan
items.summary: JPMorgan has issued a bullish forecast for India's Nifty 50 index, projecting it will reach 29,000 by the end of 2027. The investment bank also expects the RBI to implement 75 basis points of rate hikes in the current cycle, suggesting continued confidence in India's economic growth trajectory despite global uncertainties.

items.title: Norse Atlantic suspends all flights, faces potential collapse
items.feedTitle: Norse Atlantic suspends all flights as it faces potential collapse
items.summary: Norse Atlantic, a low-cost European airline, has suspended all flights and warned it may file for bankruptcy after its share price collapsed. The suspension disrupts travel plans for thousands of passengers and raises concerns about additional airline failures in a challenging post-pandemic aviation market. Pakistan's national carrier PIA is adjusting its UK flight operations as a result.

items.title: Trump proposes new tariffs on 14 trading partners
items.feedTitle: Trump proposing new tariffs on 14 partners including China and EU
items.summary: The Trump administration is proposing new tariffs on 14 trading partners including China and the European Union, with a proposed 20% additional tax on most Chinese imports that would bring total levies to approximately 40%. The tariffs are set to take effect in early 2027 and have drawn criticism from multiple countries, including Brazil and the EU, as market-distorting trade warfare.

finance.note: Global stocks rallied on Thanksgiving as investors rebounded from recent AI and tech jitters, with particular strength in IT stocks and consumer-focused sectors. Oil prices have been pressured by Middle East tensions and Houthi refinery strikes, though prices have stabilized as markets await further escalation signals. Tariff uncertainty remains a key pressure, with Trump's proposed 20% China tariffs and broader trade actions creating headwinds for multinational valuations and emerging markets. Watch for Black Friday retail sales data, the Fed's December rate decision, and any escalation in Middle East shipping disruptions.

cards.title: Emergency funds need weather-proofing
cards.insight: The St. Louis snowstorm left 125,000 homes without power for days, disrupting ATMs, card readers, and digital banking. Households that keep a small cash reserve—separate from digital savings—remained functional when infrastructure failed.
cards.takeaway: Keep at least $500-$1,000 in physical cash at home in a secure location, separate from your wallet, to cover essentials during extended outages or emergencies.

cards.title: Tech stock concentration amplifies portfolio swings
cards.insight: Recent AI selloffs followed by Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia triggered dramatic daily swings in portfolios heavy in mega-cap tech. Investors overweighted in AI-related stocks experienced sharper drawdowns and recoveries than diversified portfolios.
cards.takeaway: Review your portfolio's sector concentration; aim for no single sector representing more than 25–30% of your holdings to absorb volatility more gracefully.

cards.title: Immigration visa changes create job mobility risks
cards.insight: IBM's abrupt end to H-1B sponsorship and proposed PERM rule changes signal tightening labor mobility. Workers reliant on visa sponsorship face forced relocation or job loss with little notice, undermining career stability.
cards.takeaway: If your career depends on work visas, build a 6–12 month emergency fund (not just 3–6 months) to cushion sudden job transitions, and diversify your relocation options geographically.

cards.title: Tariff uncertainty creates pricing windows
cards.insight: Trump's proposed tariffs on China, the EU, and Brazil are set for early 2027. Companies and consumers are racing to place orders before tariffs kick in, creating temporary price spikes and supply shortages in advance of announced dates.
cards.takeaway: If planning major purchases (electronics, appliances, vehicles) with tariff-sensitive inputs, prioritize buying before year-end to avoid tariff-driven price increases; avoid panic-buying that inflates personal debt.

ai.title: Anthropic stock opens trading on public markets
ai.feedTitle: Anthropic Stock Is Now Trading as ANT. Should You Buy Today or Wait?
ai.summary: Anthropic, the AI safety-focused company founded by former OpenAI researchers, has launched its IPO at $83 per share and begun trading on public markets under ticker ANT. The company's founders cashed out $1.96 billion in the offering, marking a major milestone for the AI startup sector and providing a significant liquidity event for early investors.

ai.title: US tightens AI chip export controls targeting Chinese firms
ai.feedTitle: US chip curbs, distillation crackdown threaten Chinese AI model development, sources say
ai.summary: The US government has implemented stricter controls on AI chip exports to China and Chinese-owned companies, with reports indicating that some US-based but Chinese-owned firms have been able to purchase Nvidia's most advanced chips. The enhanced enforcement reflects escalating efforts to restrict China's AI development capabilities through semiconductor supply chain controls.

ai.title: India launches Chariot-1 AI model suite for language tasks
ai.feedTitle: India launches Chariot-1 AI suite with three language-model sizes trained together
ai.summary: India has launched Chariot-1, a new AI model suite backed by the IndiaAI Mission, featuring three language model sizes trained together for Indian languages and use cases. The release positions India as an emerging player in developing locally-relevant large language models and reduces dependence on foreign AI systems.
